10204.source_text: [auto] [limit 1] if your leader is a ≪universe 2≫ card: when this card is played, draw 1 card, send up to 1 {rozie, witchy warrior} from your drop to your warp, add up to 1 black ≪maiden squadron≫ card from your drop or warp to your z-energy, then send up to 2 battle cards from your opponent's drop to their owner's warp.

10205.source_text: [auto] [limit 1] when this card is played, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, choose up to 2 ≪universe 2≫ cards, add up to 1 card to your hand, send up to 1 card to your warp, then shuffle your deck.
